description: Open a return on an order for items the customer is sending back. A return opened by the merchant starts approved. It does not move money or stock: receive_return restocks, refund_return records the refund. Pass an idempotencyKey and, if the call times out or fails unclearly, retry with the same idempotencyKey so the retry cannot open a second return on the order.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own unique value for this return (e.g. a UUID you generate), up to 128 characters. If the call times out or its result is unclear, retry with the same idempotencyKey: the repeat returns the return the first call created instead of creating a second one, and ignores the repeat's other input. Use a new value for a different return. Omit it and every call creates.

lines.description: Lines and quantities coming back; only units already handed to the carrier or the customer

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number of the return parcel

name: create_return
title: Create return
